members.docComment:
/**
 * Type for event-emitter, with args-types for the listener on each event-name.
 *
 * The args types are a tuple type, typically indicating a single arg for the event.
 *
 * @public
 */
members.name: ClientEvents

members.docComment:
/**
 * Creates a new client instance for interacting with a Dred neighborhood.
 *
 * @remarks
 *
 * the client can be initiated with a single message-handler, which is called for all messages received from any channel. set client.messageHandler = ... to use this approach.
 *
 * Alternatively, the client can provide per-channel message-handlers, which are called for messages received from specific channels. Use client.subscribeToChannels(\{[chanId]: handler\}) to set up per-channel handlers.
 *
 * @public
 */
members.name: DredClient

members.docComment:
/**
 * Promise-based wrapper for waiting for an event to occur
 *
 * @remarks
 *
 * The promise resolves with the event arguments.
 */
members.name: once

members.docComment:
/**
 * modifies the client's list of channel subscriptions
 *
 * @remarks
 */
members.name: subscribeToChannels
